step1.title: Copy this code
step1.text: It's the same for every page and never changes. Changes you make in the dashboard show up on your website automatically.

step2.title: Add it to your website
step2.text: Paste the code once, so it's on every page: just before the closing </body> tag, or in your website builder's setting for code in the footer.

wordpress.name: WordPress
wordpress.how: Install the free plugin “WPCode”. Go to Code Snippets → Header & Footer, paste the code into “Footer” and save.

wix.name: Wix
wix.how: Go to Settings → Custom code → Add custom code. Paste the code, choose “All pages” and “Body – end”, then apply.

squarespace.name: Squarespace
squarespace.how: Go to Settings → Advanced → Code injection, paste the code into “Footer” and save. Needs a Business plan or higher.

webflow.name: Webflow
webflow.how: Open Site settings → Custom code, paste the code into “Footer code”, save and publish the site.

other.name: Another system or a web agency
other.how: Most systems have a field for code in the footer, often under “Tracking”, “Scripts” or “Custom code”. If you can't find it, send the code to whoever maintains your website.

delegate.text: Someone else looks after your website? Send them the code with these instructions.
delegate.button: Email it to your web team
delegate.subject: Please add our chatbot ({name}) to the website
delegate.body:
Hello,

please add the following code to every page of our website, just before the closing </body> tag (or in the footer code setting of the CMS):

{code}

It loads our chatbot. Nothing else needs to be configured.

Thank you!

step3.title: Check that it shows up
step3.text: Open your website. A round chat button appears in the bottom-right corner. Click it and ask a question.
step3.cache: Don't see it? Reload the page with Ctrl+Shift+R (Cmd+Shift+R on a Mac); some websites cache pages for a few minutes.
step3.consent: Using a cookie banner that blocks scripts? Allow this script there; the chatbot itself sets no cookies.

welcome.title: Welcome! Let's set up your chatbot.
welcome.lede: In about ten minutes you'll have a chatbot that answers questions about your website. We'll guide you step by step; no technical knowledge needed.

create.title: Create the chatbot
create.text: Name, website and who it answers.

read.title: Read the website
read.text: We read your pages and documents. This is free.

look.title: Choose the look
look.text: We take colours and logo from your website.

learn.title: Let it learn
learn.text: You see exactly what it costs beforehand and confirm it yourself.

install.title: Install
install.text: A small code snippet for your website, or you send it to your webmaster.

tips: You can stop at any time: with "Continue later" nothing is lost.
Everything you set here can be changed later in the dashboard.

basics.title: Which website is it about?
basics.lede: So your chatbot knows what it's there for.
basics.name: Chatbot name
basics.nameHint: Only shown to you in the dashboard, e.g. your organisation's name.
basics.urlHint: Usually the home page. From there, the chatbot finds all other pages.
tips: "Who it answers" decides which pages are worth learning: for municipalities e.g. collection dates and fees, for companies offers and prices.
You don't need any log-in for your website. We only read what is publicly visible.

reading.title: What should the chatbot read?
reading.lede: The recommendation fits most websites. You can simply keep it.
reading.started: Reading {url} is already under way. You can carry on.
reading.excludeHint: One path or subdomain per line. These parts are skipped entirely.
tips: Reading is free. Only learning costs something, and you see the amount beforehand.
Reading continues in the background while you set up the look. Large websites take up to an hour.

look.title: How should your chatbot look and sound?
look.lede: Click an element in the preview to change its colour. "Try it" shows the chat as it will appear on your website.
look.branding: Taking colours and logo from your website …
look.brandingFound: Your website's colours and logo are applied.
look.brandingNone: We found no brand colour or logo on your website. You can choose both yourself in the preview.
look.greetingHint: The first sentence visitors see in the chat.
tips: The chatbot always answers in the language people write in, even if the greeting is in English.
Later you'll find all settings under "Configure".

learning.title: Your chatbot gets to know your website
learning.lede: First we read all pages. Then you see what learning costs and start it with one click.
learning.estimate: Learn {n} pages and documents, about CHF {cost}
learning.nothing: We found nothing worth learning on this website.
learning.balanceShort: Learning costs approx. {cost}, your balance is {balance}. Top it up, then check again.
learning.done: Done! Your chatbot now knows your website.
tips: Before learning, we sort out what isn't worth it, e.g. outdated pages. "Adjust selection" shows everything in detail.
You can close this page. Learning continues, and you'll find its progress under "Knowledge".
learning.estimateTitle: Learn {n} page or document | Learn {n} pages and documents
learning.estimateBody: Gemini reads them, splits them into sections and notes facts and dates. Unchanged pages cost nothing.

try.title: Ask your chatbot a question
try.lede: This is the real chatbot. Ask something that's on your website.
try.notYet: Your chatbot is still learning. It only knows your website once learning is finished.
tips: Below each answer, the chatbot shows on which page it found the information.
Is an answer wrong or something missing? Under "Knowledge" you can add your own answers.

install.title: Add the chatbot to your website
install.lede: A small code snippet is all it takes. If someone else looks after your website, simply email it to them.
tips: The chat button appears in the bottom right of every page that has the snippet.
You can also do this later. The instructions are always under "Install".

done.title: All done!
done.lede: Your chatbot is set up. Here's what's next:

next.knowledge: Under "Knowledge" you see what your chatbot learned and let it re-read your website regularly.
next.look: Under "Configure" you change the look, tone and suggested questions.
next.insights: Under "Insights" you see what visitors ask.

excluded.how: Leave out folders and pages in a run's estimate. They then stay left out in every run.
